name: Fancy Nancy
description: Meet Nancy Clancy, a high-spirited young girl whose imagination and enthusiasm for all that is exquisite transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary – from her vast vocabulary to her creative and elaborate attire.

videos.title: Chez Nancy
videos.overview: Nancy is upset when Dad builds her a playhouse that isn't fancy.

videos.title: School de Fancy
videos.overview: Nancy starts a charm school to teach her friends how to be fancy.

videos.title: Tea Party Trouble
videos.overview: After she breaks a family heirloom, Nancy tries to hide it.

videos.title: Bonjour Butterfly
videos.overview: When Nancy finds a butterfly, she wants to keep it.

videos.title: Nancy's Ooh La La Spa
videos.overview: Nancy tries to give Mom a perfect spa day but her homemade spa products are mistaken for snacks!

videos.title: Nancy Goes to Work
videos.overview: When Dad works from home, Nancy becomes his assistant.

videos.title: Nancy versus Dudley
videos.overview: After encouraging Jo Jo to create an imaginary friend, Nancy becomes jealous of their relationship.

videos.title: Nancy Makes Her Mark
videos.overview: Nancy tries to leave the perfect handprints in a newly cemented walkway.

videos.title: Nancy's Devine Sleepover

videos.title: Nancy's Sacré Bleu Fondue
